jobs.title: Senior Executive Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
As an Senior Executive Operations Program Manager, you will play a key role in supporting executive operations by streamlining processes, managing reports and dashboards, and ensuring effective coordination and governance. You will work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency, develop templates and training resources, and maintain key knowledge bases.

Please note, this role requires an onsite cadence of 3 days/week in our Foster City, CA office.

### **In this role, you will...**

* Lead the development, alignment, and tracking of company strategic focus areas.
* Drive executive operations by leading executive forum planning, shaping meeting agendas and content, and managing action tracking for leadership meetings and offsites.
* Support the development of monthly and quarterly company reporting documentation, synthesizing strategic initiatives, business performance metrics, and cross-functional updates into executive-ready deliverables.
* Manage and elevate the company’s VIP Visitor Program, delivering high-impact experiences.
* Lead complex cross-functional initiatives focused on operational scalability, process optimization, and organizational effectiveness through development of standardized workflows, dashboards, reporting frameworks, and visibility tools.
* Drive adoption of operational programs and resources by facilitating company-wide training, change management, and rollout strategies that improve alignment, consistency, and execution across teams.

Ideal candidates have served in senior program manager roles with significant exposure to executive leadership teams.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, CEO/COO office roles, project management, operations, chief of staff or a similar role.
* Experience with program management frameworks, strategic planning, and business operations.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, presentation, and business writing skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
* Proven track record of leveraging AI to drive operational excellence in executive operations.
* Ability to synthesize complex strategic information into cohesive narratives (not just reporting data)

### **Bonus Qualifications:**

* Experience in autonomous vehicle (AV) or technology industries.
* Familiarity with corporate governance and executive reporting.
* Extensive experience with Google Suite, Confluence and Jira.
* Strategic planning & KIP design
* Financial and operational analysis

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.description:
***The Company***

Halo Industries has developed breakthrough technology to revolutionize a decades-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser-based solution minimizes waste, enhances material cost efficiency, and drives innovations across high-growth markets, including automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo received significant funding in 2024, paving the way for rapid expansion, strategic customer engagement, and the launch of volume manufacturing.

***The Opportunity***

We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Supply Chain Program Manager to join our supply chain team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and managing both the highly specialized raw materials required for our wafers and the critical electromechanical components needed to build our proprietary manufacturing equipment.

You will also develop comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage robust supplier relationships, drive cost and quality improvements, and lead complex procurement processes.

***Key Responsibilities***

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

* Develop and Execute Commodity Strategies: Create comprehensive, multi-year sourcing strategies for raw materials and capital equipment sub-components.
* Market Intelligence: Continuously monitor global market conditions, raw material indices, and geopolitical factors impacting the semiconductor and supply chains. Conduct deep market research and analysis to identify technological trends, evaluate supplier capabilities, and proactively identify potential global risks within assigned commodity categories
* Dual-Sourcing Initiatives: Identify, qualify, and onboard primary and secondary suppliers to mitigate risk and eliminate single points of failure in the supply chain.

Supplier Relationship Management

* Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations for Master Supply Agreements, Statements of Work, and pricing contracts.
* Performance Monitoring: Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers to evaluate performance against rigorous Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Innovation metrics.
* Capacity Planning: Work closely with suppliers to ensure their manufacturing capacity aligns with our long-term production forecasts and equipment build schedules.
* Supplier Relations: Research, select, and manage strategic suppliers; conduct performance reviews, monitor KPIs (quality, delivery), and negotiate contracts.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* New Product Introduction: Partner with R&D and the NPI Team during the design phase of new tools to ensure Design for Manufacturability and supply chain viability.
* Cost Reduction: Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to identify Value Analysis/Value Engineering opportunities, thereby driving down the Bill of Materials cost
* Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for critical supply shortages, leading cross-functional task forces to resolve bottlenecks and prevent production downtime.
* Program Management: Collaborate daily with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, NPI, and Finance teams to align commodity strategies with overall business objectives, production schedules, and product design phases. Participate in corporate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance end-to-end supply chain processes, reduce lifecycle costs, and mitigate risks.

  
**Requirements**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Mechanical, Materials Science, or Electrical), Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain within the semiconductor, capital equipment, or advanced materials industries.
* Proficiency reading engineering drawings and understand complex technical specifications related to both raw materials (purity levels, material properties) and equipment components (tolerances, vacuum standards).
* Experience performing complex cost modeling, Should-Cost analysis, and Total Cost of Ownership evaluations.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) and PLM software (e.g., Arena).
* Direct experience in the semiconductor or related high-tech industries.
* Direct experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI), including supplier selection and qualification for engineering prototypes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced negotiation skills with a history of executing favorable long-term contracts in volatile markets.

* Experience developing and executing successful, long-term global commodity sourcing strategies for specialized materials or capital equipment components.
* Familiarity with global supply chain management complexity, geopolitical factors, and risk mitigation planning.
* Experience with the complexities of compliance driven procurement for automotive or IATF 16949.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

**Other Requirements**

* This is a full-time role primarily based onsite at our Santa Clara, CA office.
* Some domestic and international travel may be required (up to 10%).

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food & Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible
* Short Term & Long Term Disability

* Base Salary: $140,000 - $160,000

*Additional Information*

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Hospital Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Inizio Engage has partnered with CSL Behring!

We are seeking a performance-driven Hospital Sales Specialist who is passionate about making a difference in healthcare. This role is responsible for managing all aspects of territory business development, cultivating relationships within key hospital accounts, and driving education and awareness around a critical treatment portfolio to Health Care Professionals (HCP), hospital decision-makers/influencers, pharmacy, infusion suites, and C-Suite stakeholders.

This position requires strong clinical and disease state knowledge and the ability to understand the complexities of the U.S. hospital market to facilitate the development of new accounts while supporting the growth of existing accounts. The role also includes active collaboration with Regional Sales Manager and stakeholders such as marketing, medical affairs, healthcare systems, and operations to ensure alignment on integrated strategic plans. Hospital Sales Specialists will be expected to support appropriate patient education programs as needed.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

* Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
* Company-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
* Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
* Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
* A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference

We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

* Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
* Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026

Learn more: https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified-company/7003732

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

  

* Develop new accounts and the growth of existing accounts through solid customer relationships, communication of technical product and disease state information, and effective territory management skills.
* Implement key marketing programs to increase the market share of key promoted products.
* Implement CSL Behring’s patient-focused hospital selling model with effective opening, probing, listening, and closing skills on customer calls.
* Maintain proper call frequency with assigned targets and update as needed to ensure time is aligned with a current product focus
* Develop and implement territory business plans consistent with corporate direction designed to achieve/exceed territory sales targets. Appropriate knowledge of product features and benefits, competitive products and programs and distribution channels.
* Use appropriate resources to create a compelling and logical rationale for the value of promoted products during informed discussions with customers, knowing how to compare, contrast, and position CSL Behring’s brand(s) versus competitor products.

* Comprehend complex account interdependencies to proactively develop and execute short- and long-term account plans in collaboration with the account team and supervisor.
* Ensure a consistent customer experience by effectively communicating and collaborating with Associate Sales Director, Hospital Accounts, Corporate Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, Medical Science Liaison, and more.
* Outstanding in all competency areas (Account Management; External Market Focus; 1:1 Customer Interactions, Clinical Expertise, Business Acumen)

**Key Job Specifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in business or life sciences
* 5+ years’ hospital/institutional sales experience required from relevant roles within the pharmaceutical industry
* Demonstrated history of documented achievement of sales performance
* Experience with patient groups, hospital pharmacies, and distributors is a plus
* Ability to demonstrate effective management of a large geography

The base pay range for this position is $102K – $189K per year. The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, internal equity, and business needs.

Our passionate, global workforce augments local expertise and diverse mix of skills with data, science, and technology to deliver bespoke engagement solutions that help clients reimagine how they engage with their patients, payers, people, and providers to improve treatment outcomes. Our mission is to partner with our clients, improving lives by helping healthcare professionals and patients get the medicines, knowledge and support they need.

We believe in our values: We empower everyone/We rise to the challenge/We work as one/We ask what if/We do the right thing, and we will ask you how your personal values align to them.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant and Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**

Turner & Townsend is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and business-focused **Executive Assistant & Operations Manager** to support senior leadership while overseeing key operational, governance, compliance, and administrative functions across the business.

This role serves as a trusted partner to leadership, ensuring priorities are effectively managed, business operations run efficiently, and governance, risk, and client care activities are coordinated and tracked.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Executive Support**

* Provide proactive administrative support to senior leadership, including complex calendar management, meeting coordination, and travel planning.
* Anticipate priorities, identify potential issues, and take action to ensure effective execution of leadership objectives.
* Prepare briefing materials, presentations, reports, and executive communications.
* Plan and coordinate leadership, management, governance, and board meetings.
* Develop agendas, meeting materials, decision logs, action registers, and follow-up reports.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements and itineraries.
* Manage confidential and sensitive business information with discretion and professionalism.
* Serve as a key point of contact between leadership and internal and external stakeholders.

**Operations & Business Management**

* Coordinate operational activities to support business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Establish and maintain operational processes, procedures, and documentation.
* Track strategic initiatives, actions, and leadership commitments to ensure timely completion.
* Maintain operational records and reporting systems.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and reporting tools for leadership teams.
* Produce regular reports related to operational performance, compliance activities, risk management, governance actions, and client care initiatives.
* Coordinate client care and satisfaction tracking activities.
* Maintain client action logs and monitor follow-through on commitments and improvement actions.

**Governance, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Maintain oversight of action items and accountability tracking across leadership teams.
* Support annual planning cycles, business reviews, and strategic planning activities.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of compliance programs, internal controls, and business policies.
* Maintain risk registers and monitor mitigation actions in partnership with leadership teams.
* Assist with audit preparation, policy reviews, governance reporting requirements, and business continuity activities.
* Monitor business risks, issues, and escalation items, ensuring appropriate visibility and follow-through.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and client governance expectations.
* SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Minimum of 5 years' experience supporting senior executives, business leaders, or operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating governance, compliance, risk management, or business operations activities.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.

**Success Measures**

* Effective support of senior leadership and strategic priorities.
* Timely execution of leadership actions, governance activities, and business initiatives.
* Strong compliance and risk management oversight.
* Accurate and timely management reporting.
* Effective client care tracking and follow-through.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and operational excellence.

  
**Additional Information**

**The salary range for this full-time role is** **$90K-$120K** **per year.** Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package. Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications.

* ***On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.***

  
Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

jobs.description:
**Who we're looking for**

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Process Manager to shape how our go-to-market engine actually works.

In this role, you'll own the business processes, governance, and operating framework that powers our upper-funnel revenue engine. processes within our ABM tool 6sense. Your focus isn't on configuring the system; it's on defining how work should flow across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, so everything operates as one cohesive system. You will define how target accounts are identified, prioritized, routed, engaged, and progressed through the buyer journey using 6sense as a core component of our operating model.

You'll act as the bridge between business and technical teams, translating GTM strategy into clear, scalable process logic and requirements.

This is a process architecture role, not a systems administration role. Success isn't measured by tickets closed or configurations shipped; it is measured by clarity, scalability, adoption, and performance.

Your focus is not system administration or campaign execution. Instead, you'll design the business logic, workflows, decision frameworks, and governance that ensure our account-based strategy translates into consistent execution.

**What You Will Own**

**Design End to End GTM processes**

* Build and evolve workflows across Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Customer Success
* Ensure inbound, outbound, and account-based motions work together as a unified system
* Define lifecycle stages, ownership models, and clean handoffs across teams
* Design how target accounts move from identification through engagement, opportunity creation, and pipeline progression
* Establish account stages, buying stages, ownership models, and engagement plays
* Ensure inbound, outbound, and ABM motions operate as a coordinated system rather than independent workflows

**Translate Strategy into Execution**

* Translate GTM strategy into:
  + Process flows
  + Decision logic
  + Business requirements
  + Acceptance criteria
* Partner closely with CRM and Systems teams, acting as the primary interface with GTM stakeholders
* Ensure implementations reflect business intent (not just technical feasibility)

**Own Process Governance & Data Clarity**

* Define and enforce:
  + Source-of-truth definitions
  + Data ownership models
  + Process standards across systems
* Create clear, human-readable documentation so teams understand how things work

**Define routing, prioritization, and signals**

* Design lead, account, and opportunity routing strategies
* Build prioritization frameworks based on segmentation and signals
* Eliminate gaps, duplication, and conflicting engagement paths

**Drive Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define SLAs, KPIs, thresholds, and success criteria across GTM motions
* Design and deliver high quality process training to drive GTM team members to optimize day to day activities
* Monitor process health (e.g., coverage, routing accuracy, adoption)
* Continuously iterate as GTM strategy, segments, and tooling evolve

**What Success Looks Like**

* GTM processes are clearly defined, consistently executed, and widely adopted
* Stakeholders understand how the system works without relying on tribal knowledge
* Salesforce reflects intentional design, not incremental patchwork
* Process changes are scalable, testable, and measurable
* Business and systems teams operate with shared clarity and alignment

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a Salesforce Administrator — does not own configuration or system builds
* Not a Marketo / campaign execution role
* Not a reporting or analytics-only function
* Not a ticket-based support role for CRM requests

**What** **We're** **Looking For**

* 5+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, or Sales/Marketing Operations
* High learning agility and analytical thinking
* Proven ownership of lead management, routing, or demand processes in complex GTM environments
* Experience working across Sales, Marketing, SDR, and Systems teams
* Exposure to ABM tools like 6sense
* Exposure to different revenue intelligence tools, such as Marketo, Groove, Dialpad and Gong
* Proven experience operating in a scaled B2B organization (SaaS or complex GTM preferred)
* Process-first thinker — designs for clarity, scalability, and real-world usability
* Exceptional written communicator — translates complexity into clear logic and specs
* Systems translator — bridges business needs and technical implementation seamlessly
* Structured problem solver — brings order to ambiguity and incomplete inputs
* Influencer without authority — earns trust across senior GTM and technical stakeholders
* Detail-oriented but outcome-driven — balances precision with business impact

**Compensation:**

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: **$97,000 - $130,000**

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors such as your skills, qualifications and experience. In addition to the salary you may be eligible for a corporate bonus which can range **up to 30%.**

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account**

Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Partner Operations Manager will build the operational foundation that enables Happen’s personal loan partnerships to launch, scale, and perform reliably. You’ll bring structure to complex cross-functional work across Product, Engineering, Credit, Risk, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Analytics, creating the workflows, governance, and visibility that keep partner initiatives moving. Success in this role means faster execution, stronger controls, clearer accountability, and a more scalable partner operating model.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and continuously improve scalable operating workflows for partner onboarding, launches, marketing changes, product enhancements, compliance reviews, and ongoing partner management
* Partner with the internal team on cross-functional delivery plans from concept through execution, managing milestones, dependencies, approvals, risks, decisions, and launch-readiness requirements while driving open items to resolution
* Support the coordination of regulatory examinations, audits, compliance reviews, and internal control activities by organizing evidence, managing deadlines, tracking remediation items, and maintaining clear documentation
* Create and maintain a reliable source of truth for partner agreements, contacts, product configurations, technical requirements, marketing materials, approvals, key decisions, and operating procedures
* Monitor partner and business performance, investigate trends and anomalies, and translate findings into clear actions, recommendations, and follow-up
* Lead recurring operating cadences and develop concise executive updates that communicate performance, risks, decisions, priorities, and recommended next steps
* Identify opportunities to simplify or redesign manual, duplicative, or unclear processes, using AI and automation where appropriate to improve speed, quality, accountability, and visibility
* Contribute to the operational response to urgent partner issues and special initiatives, applying sound judgment to balance speed, partner needs, regulatory requirements, and long-term scalability

**About You**
-------------

* 4+ years of experience in partner operations, business operations, program management, implementation, or a related field within fintech, banking, consumer lending, or a high-growth technology company; bachelor's degree in a related field; or equivalent work experience
* You have experience building or supporting operational workflows, playbooks, governance structures, documentation systems, and repeatable processes that improve how teams execute
* You bring strong program management skills and can create clarity in ambiguous situations while managing dependencies, risks, priorities, and a high volume of moving pieces
* You take ownership of outcomes, proactively identify what needs to happen next, and influence cross-functional stakeholders to reach decisions and deliver on commitments
* You have experience supporting audits, regulatory examinations, compliance reviews, third-party oversight, or other documentation-intensive control processes
* You are comfortable interpreting dashboards and business performance reporting, investigating changes, and translating data into practical actions and recommendations
* You communicate complex information clearly and can adapt the level of detail depending on your audience
* You actively look for ways AI and emerging tools can improve workflows and output quality, while applying strong judgment around accuracy, data sensitivity, controls, and where human review matters most

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with unsecured personal loans or another consumer credit product

  Experience working across both a regulated financial institution and a fast-paced fintech or technology environment

  Familiarity with digital lending funnels, partner integrations, APIs, and third-party marketing or distribution channels

  Knowledge of third-party risk management, marketing compliance, and consumer lending regulations

San Francisco

As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed.

jobs.description:
P-1495

### **About Databricks**

### **The Deputy Program Manager will serve as the primary interface to Government customers for assigned tasks and to provide leadership and management to contractor staff. The DPM will report directly to the ASSESS Program Manager with responsibility for managing a portfolio of activities under contract. The DPM will participate in managing the interface between local contract management and corporate management. The successful DPM candidate may exercise all of the responsibilities and authority of the Program Manager when the PM is on leave or such responsibilities and authority is delegated. This position is in Mountain View, CA.**

### **Salary range $170,000 to $250,000, based on skill level and experience.**

### **Responsibilities:**

* ### **Communicate effectively with customers and ensure high contractor performance.**
* ### **Lead integrated resource management and coordination**
* ### **Perform strategic workforce planning including skills vitalization**
* ### **Supervise and mentor technical staff, including performance evaluations and promoting skills development**
* ### **Promote cross-cutting technical innovation discussions and forums**
* ### **Lead overall quality assurance tracking and inform quality approaches, supported by corporate S&MA**
* ### **Identify technical, schedule, cost, and organizational conflict of interest (OCI) and performance risks and formulate handling strategies.**
* ### **Manage subcontractors and consultants on assigned tasks.**
* ### **Foster, grow and maintain positive relationships with existing and new customers along management and technical interfaces.**
* ### **Support corporate initiatives and process improvements efforts that benefit across multiple contracts**

* ### **Bachelor’s degree in science or engineering. Additional education, training, or certification in management, leadership, or project management preferred.**
* ### **Minimum ten (10) years of experience leading and/or managing groups of scientists and engineers in a research environment involving sciences or engineering.**
* ### **Minimum five (5) years of experience planning and leading complex, multidisciplinary scientific programs, including building and maintaining technical collaborations.**
* ### **Minimum five (5) years of experience managing an organization of twenty (20) or more science, engineering, and/or IT professionals in a contracting environment.**
* ### **Experience supporting NASA programs strongly desired.**
* ### **Excellent written and oral presentation skills.**
* ### **Effective management of priorities.**
* ### **Able to communicate effectively with customers.**

### **Total Vision LLC is a group of highly successful optometry practices that have aligned towards a common goal of world-class eye-care results for its patients and California communities. We are a company that is seeing significant growth and are looking for top-notch team members with the passion, energy, focus and commitment to excel in this type of environment.**

### **Major Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Warmly greet incoming patients upon entering the practice and complete the check-in process.**
* **Administrative duties including answering telephones, scheduling patient appointments per doctor preferences and transcribing messages for return calls and faxes.**
* **Obtain and verify insurance eligibility for all applicable patients. Responsible for auditing and editing insurance claims as needed.**
* **Scanning and entering routing slips and other documents into EHR.**
* **Confirm all appointments for the following day and reschedule no show appointments. Also utilize practice’s recall system.**
* **Pull and prepare charts for all patients scheduled for the following day.**
* **Processing sales of contact lens through phone calls or doctor transitions.**
* **Responsible for keeping the front desk organized at all times.**
* **Opening and closing procedures determined by practice.**
* **All other duties as assigned.**

### **Required Skills/Knowledge:**

* **Demonstrated flexibility in addressing a broad spectrum of patient requirements and preferences.**
* **Demonstrated ability to cultivate positive patient rapport and build relationships while increase patient-retention.**
* **Strong communication skills (oral and written) with the proven ability to manage priorities in a fast paced environment.**
* **Ability to multi-task, set priorities and ensure that patient commitments/deadlines are met.**
* **Proficiency in utilization of automated equipment and systems standard to the optometry industry.**

### **Qualifications:**

* **High school diploma, GED or equivalent.**
* **Experience in the Ophthalmic/Optometric/medical industry is a plus but is not required.**

### **Physical Requirements:**

* **Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.**
* **Hand dexterity and eye and hand coordination is critical.**
* **Lifting. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. Use of one or both arms and wrists to lift parts, fixtures, and tools on a frequent basis.**
* **Sitting. Must be able to sit for long periods of time.**
* **Standing. Particularly for sustained periods of time.**
* **Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately or quickly.**
* **Travel as needed between practices.**
* **Required to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned or to make general observations of structures. Must be able to read a computer screen for long periods of time.**
* **Walking. Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly for long distances or moving from one workstation to another.**

For roles that are remote (i.e., Work From Home (WFH)) or hybrid (i.e., partial onsite at a VSP location and WFH), must demonstrate a high level of engagement in virtual environments, including maintaining camera presence during meetings to support effective communication and team alignment.

Compensation range for the roles is listed above. Applicable salary rangers may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. As a part of the compensation package, this role may include eligible bonuses, equity, and commissions.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Associate
jobs.description:
**About SleepRes**

SleepRes is developing next-generation sleep apnea therapy technologies that improve patient outcomes. We are a small, fast-moving R&D team focused on building high-quality medical devices that make a real-world impact.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Assurance (QA) Associate supports the daily operation and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) for Class II medical devices. Reporting to the Quality Manager, this role coordinates document control, manages day-to-day training program activities, administers the electronic QMS (eQMS), and supports customer feedback and complaint handling.

The QA Associate works with Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Care to maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready records. This is an individual contributor role that supports design control, risk management, and medical device software compliance under the Quality Manager's direction.

**Responsibilities**

**Document Control**

* Administer document control activities within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including document creation, review, approval routing, release, revision, distribution, obsolescence, and archival in accordance with approved procedures.

* Maintain document numbering, revision history, effective dates, controlled templates, and applicable external standards within the eQMS, ensuring obsolete or superseded documents are appropriately controlled and protected from unintended use.

* Review documents and change records for completeness, formatting, required approvals, and associated training assignments; follow up on open actions.

**Training Program Management**

* Administer the company training program through the eQMS, including maintenance of the training matrix, role-based curricula, onboarding requirements, recurring training, and training triggered by new or revised controlled documents.

* Support onboarding and role changes by ensuring employees are assigned the appropriate eQMS training curricula based on job responsibilities.

* Assign and track training in the eQMS, follow up on overdue assignments, and report completion status to the Quality Manager and department leads.

* Maintain training and competency records, including evidence of training effectiveness where required by procedures.

**eQMS Administration**

* Support eQMS day-to-day administration, including approved user access, workflows, document and training modules, and user assistance.

* Support controlled configuration changes, data migration, testing, and validation documentation under approved plans; escalate system and data integrity issues.

Feedback and Complaint Support

* Log customer feedback and complaints, obtain missing information, and maintain traceability to the device, serial number, event, and supporting records.

* Coordinate follow-up with Customer Care, Engineering, and Operations; support complaint investigations, record completeness checks, and tracking to closure.

* Promptly escalate potential safety issues and time-sensitive events to Quality and Regulatory for evaluation and reporting decisions; prepare complaint and feedback trend summaries.

**Design Control Risk Management and Software Compliance Support**

* Maintain and organize design and development records, including design reviews, verification and validation evidence, traceability matrices, and design change documentation.

* Support maintenance of risk management records and links among identified hazards, risk controls, verification evidence, and post-market feedback using knowledge of ISO 14971.

* Support review and organization of software lifecycle records using knowledge of IEC 62304 requirements, including software requirements, verification, configuration and change management, and problem resolution.

**Quality System Support**

* Support internal and external audits by retrieving records and tracking assigned actions; assist with nonconformance and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) documentation.

* Compile quality metrics, identify record gaps, and follow up on assigned actions. Escalate compliance concerns and decisions requiring approval to the Quality Manager.

**Experience and Required Knowledge**

* 3-5 years of experience in medical device quality or related quality systems work, including experience with Class II medical devices.

* Practical experience with document control, training coordination, and electronic document or quality management systems.

* Working knowledge of FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), 21 CFR Part 820, and ISO 13485 quality system requirements.

* Knowledge of medical device design control, ISO 14971 risk management, and IEC 62304 medical device software lifecycle requirements.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, biomedical engineering, life sciences, quality, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CPAP or other respiratory therapy devices, connected hardware/software medical devices, or eQMS implementation.

* Experience supporting complaint handling, audits, CAPA, or software verification and validation documentation.

**Key Competencies and Work Environment**

Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and follow-through. Ability to manage multiple assignments, handle confidential information, and collaborate across technical and customer-facing teams in a medical device development and commercial environment.

Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
The HealthRIGHT 360 ECM program is based in the Integrated Care Center Clinic, a federally qualified health center that provides primary care, behavioral health, addiction treatment, psychiatry, dental care, and more. We provide care to those most in need including those who are suffering from homelessness, mental illness, substance use, mental illness, and chronic medical conditions. We provide team-based care in an integrated care setting. We are looking for a mission driven service leader who works well in a team, has experience with managing and supporting members, champions quality improvement, leads change, and is excited to innovate.
  
  
The Care Manager will provide intensive, client-centered case management to support both patients in the ICC and across other HealthRIGHT 360 programs in San Francisco, in achieving stability, health, and self-sufficiency. The Case Manager I, under the Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program, is responsible for maintaining a caseload of members enrolled in a Managed Care Plan (MCP). This role focuses on delivering community-based case management services, linking clients to appropriate resources to address needs such as health benefits, physical and behavioral health care, substance use treatment, housing, employment, justice-involved issues, family services, and other social supports. This includes collaboration with clinical and community providers to ensure comprehensive service delivery.
  
  
This is a field-based position requiring proactive outreach and engagement with members in the community, including visits to clients' homes, service provider sites, and other locations across San Francisco.

* The Care Manager will be responsible for organizing patient care activities, sharing information with those involved as part of the multi-disciplinary care team, and implementing activities identified in the Managed Care Plan.
* Identifying eligible people from within State Prisons, County Jails, hospitals, and other locations for enrollment into ECM.

**About the team**

Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) builds compliance programs and provides assurance for OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We combine technical understanding with practical operations to reduce risk, support product and research teams, and produce reliable evidence of how our controls work.

**About the role**

As a Regulatory Compliance Program Manager, you will build and operate programs that turn regulatory requirements into clear responsibilities, effective processes, and evidence that can withstand external scrutiny.

Your work will focus on AI safety/security and content moderation, with privacy operations as an adjacent area. You will partner with Legal and the teams that build and operate our products to scope the work, maintain accurate control narratives, prepare regulatory responses, and lead external assessments for your assigned portfolio.

You should be comfortable owning delivery, explaining tradeoffs, and changing your recommendation when the evidence changes. Success means controls have accountable owners, evidence stays current, and teams can respond accurately without repeatedly rebuilding the same work. The initial portfolio and expectations will be agreed with the hiring manager.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead an agreed portfolio of AI safety/security and content-compliance work, including programs associated with the EU AI Act, DSA, OSA, and SB 53, with Legal and relevant experts confirming applicable requirements.
* Translate requirements into scoped programs, operating processes, control and evidence responsibilities, milestones, and clear escalation paths.
* Build and maintain accurate control narratives and traceable evidence for regulatory requests, reporting, audits, and assessments.
* Lead preparation and delivery for external compliance assessments, coordinate the responsible teams, and track gaps through verified resolution or an explicitly owned decision.
* Prioritize the work that materially improves compliance outcomes and reduces risk; explain what should proceed, change, or wait and why.
* Develop evidence-backed recommendations with Legal, Product, Security, Safety, Integrity, Privacy, and other functional teams. Obtain decisions from the authorized owners for legal interpretation, external representations, and risk acceptance.
* Improve operational workflows for content and privacy compliance while keeping implementation and operation of controls with the appropriate functional owners.

* Understand relevant technical concepts across model evaluation, training and release, safety controls, content moderation, and post-launch operations, and can explain where specialist input is needed.

jobs.description:
### **About Us**

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

### **Role Overview**

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how money and identity get into OG: signup, KYC, fiat funding, payouts, and the funding experience behind all of it. Fans can’t trade until they can fund, so every drop-off in onboarding or funding costs us volume, trust, and share of wallet.

Your job is to make funded accounts fast and trustworthy, with a design bar you won’t lower. You’ll own the path from signup through KYC and funding to a trade-ready account: the funding methods that actually clear, the failure states that quietly kill conversion, and the feedback loops that move the funnel. Trading surfaces like markets, parlays, and live sit with a partner PM. The front door is yours.

The funding product is yours end to end, including funding methods, limits, retries, risk configuration, and partner UX. You won’t be negotiating bank charters. You’ll be deciding what ships, when, and at what balance of friction against compliance. You’ll report to the VP of Product, who sets strategy across Financial Services while you own the how and the when for OG.com.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* **Own onboarding and funding end to end.** Signup, verify, deposit, time-to-funded. You make the call on where to trade friction for compliance. The job isn’t shipping a KYC screen; it’s getting people from signup to funded to ready for their first trade.
* **Own the funding product.** You decide funding methods, payouts, limits, retries, and partner UX, spanning ACH, cards, instant funding, and whatever else clears in the U.S. Authorization and flow of funds are product decisions to you, not a ticket you file with a vendor.
* **Treat the money-in funnel as a growth surface.** You instrument the drop-off, go after the leaks, and sequence your work against conversion. On the handoff from funded to first contract, you partner with the Predictions PM.
* **Hold the design bar on trust and money UX.** Clarity, hierarchy, and clean error states aren’t negotiable. When someone’s entering a debit card or waiting on an ACH, “good enough” doesn’t cut it, and you’ll say so. Your feedback is specific: interaction cost, copy, recovery paths, not vibes.
* **Wireframe and partner on design.** You build your own wires and drive the design conversation, catching the clunky funding and KYC moments before users hit them.
* **Talk to users like a peer.** You run research on how people really sign up, verify, and move money. You ask them to show you how they fund an account instead of asking whether they’d use instant deposit.
* **Drive cross-functional execution.** You get engineering, design, data, compliance, payments, and ops working toward the same funded-user outcomes. Nothing in onboarding or funding ships without your sign-off on the product and UX bar.

### **Requirements:**

* **Consumer money-in funnel ownership.** You’ve owned a consumer signup-to-deposit-to-funded flow, and you can walk us through the funnel you ran, the drop-offs you went after, and the number that actually moved. That’s the bar. Merchant acquiring, B2B payouts, and adjacent-team contributions don’t count.
* **Hands-on flow-of-funds ownership at the bank-API layer, not just a gateway.** You’ve done real work integrating bank or embedded-banking APIs, whether direct bank and partner-bank APIs or a banking-as-a-service or rails provider, and you’ve owned a funding method, rail, or failure mode end to end. You can point to a specific flow of funds or failure state you ran yourself: a settlement failure, an ACH return or NACHA edge case, a retry model, a routing decision, a chargeback or liability flow. You don’t need to have built a bank core from scratch, but consuming a payment gateway and filing tickets against it won’t clear this bar. The judgment we need comes from having worked at the money layer, so you’re making sound calls on day one.
* **Design sensibility as a product skill.** You can critique money-in and identity UX with specifics like hierarchy, density, recovery, and trust, not just “it looks nicer.” Tell us about a flow you refused to ship until it was clear.
* **An instinct for why funding has to feel instant.** In a live-event context, a slow or failed deposit is volume lost in real time. You’ve designed under that pressure, or you can show us you get it.
* **Data- and user-driven by default.** You instrument your own funnel, size the opportunity, and prioritize off the numbers without waiting for someone to hand you the analysis. You also go to the source, running your own research on how people sign up, verify, and fund, and letting what you learn reshape the roadmap. Both the quantitative and the qualitative.

### **Strong Plus:**

* **KYC / identity depth.** You’ve owned identity verification, step-up, or risk-tiered challenge decisions yourself. (If a peer owned KYC while you owned deposits, that’s fine, but identity fluency helps here.)
* **Regulated on/off-ramp or neobank experience.** You’ve sat at the intersection of compliance, rails, and consumer conversion.
* **Prediction-market, sportsbook, or real-money-gaming background.** You know why funding has to feel instant during a live game.
* **Deep design-tool / design-system fluency.** You move faster treating design as a peer discipline rather than a handoff.
* **AI-augmented product work.** You use AI tools with human judgment in the loop to move faster on research,

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're hiring our first Global Account Managers to own and aggressively grow a small number of our largest global accounts — companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce.

Accounts of this scale are not one company; they're dozens. Amazon alone runs research across retail, devices, AWS, advertising, and entertainment, in a dozen countries, with separate budgets and separate buying centers in each. We're already inside these organizations and the teams who use us love us. What we don't yet have is someone whose entire job is to turn a strong foothold into an enterprise-wide standard. That's this role.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales. You'll carry full commercial ownership of your accounts — expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal — and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You will not be working a wide territory or chasing net-new logos. You'll be going deep in a handful of the most important companies in the world, finding net new buying centers and getting introduced via referrals, building the relationships and the multi-year plan that make Outset the way they understand their customers.

You'll do it with a team around you. Each global account is supported by a dedicated account team — Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team. You set the strategy and direct the effort; the resources are there to execute it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own a portfolio of a small number of strategic global accounts — companies on the scale of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce — with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Find new buying centers, both regionally and within the larger umbrella brand, to pursue, predominantly via deep account understanding, referrals and in-person visits.
* Carry and exceed an aggressive seven-figure growth target across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each logo: every buying center by business unit, region, and research function; whitespace and spend map; executive relationship map; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Multi-thread relentlessly — from practicing researchers to VPs to the C-suite — and build senior relationships durable enough to survive champion turnover, reorgs, and procurement cycles.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors), setting priorities and holding the plan together across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that reframe the relationship around business outcomes, not usage stats, and convert them into committed budgets.
* Negotiate and close complex enterprise agreements — global MSAs, enterprise-wide and multi-region commitments, multi-year structures, enterprise procurement, security and privacy review — in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Coordinate coverage globally, aligning our regional teams behind a single account strategy rather than a set of local ones.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of your accounts back into Outset — informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion itself.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in enterprise sales, including 5+ years in a named global or strategic account role (Global Account Manager, Global Account Director, Strategic Account Manager, or equivalent) owning a small book of major brands.
* Direct experience selling into and growing accounts of this profile — large, global, matrixed technology or consumer organizations with many buying centers, such as Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Salesforce.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts* — expansion, cross-sell, and renewal — not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management. You are known for the depth and durability of the relationships you build, and you can point to accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with CxO and VP-level buyers, consultative enough to teach and shape their thinking, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority — you make the people around you more effective on your accounts.
* Experience navigating complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor — a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* High ownership, opinionated, proactive, and comfortable with a very fast pace of both decision-making and execution in a startup that is still building the playbook.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

  

**The Problem You'll Solve**

Something is always happening - a game, a vote, a number moving - and OG is where traders come to discover it and make their call. That’s the reflex we’re building: the surface should feel like it was built for this exact moment - every time someone opens the app, their obvious next step should always be acting on what’s happening right now.

You will lead merchandising for OG’s surface - deciding what’s featured, how it’s packaged, and how it evolves in real time. You bring the instincts of someone deeply in tune with sports, politics, and real-world events, paired with fluency in how a prediction market trades, to make OG’s surface feel current and alive at every moment.

You will operate with autonomy - proposing and making the calls on what’s featured, how it’s packaged, and what comes off the board - while working closely with Product and Market Liquidity and Operations to keep the surface moving as fast as the moment does.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* Own the merchandised surface end-to-end. You lead decisions on homepage / discovery modules and featured market placement across OG web and mobile - what sits in the hero, what rotates, and what earns its place. Every decision is made against one question: does this get tapped, traded, and come back tomorrow. You make decisions that offer the best commercial quality, working closely with Product along the way.
* Bring proven merchandising craft to prediction markets. You bring instincts for hero carousels, quick-pick modules, thematic tiles, and high-intent packaging, and translate them into prediction-market terms: multi-contract packages, correlated event bundles, and narrative-driven hubs that make trading on a moment feel as easy and exciting as it should.
* Build packaged, high-intent merchandising. You create and rotate packages tied to real narratives, and you package for liquidity and clarity so every trade is easy to understand and act on. You propose and make the call on what ships to the module, in step with Trading and Market Ops.
* Run live merchandising. You swap surfaces in real time during major events - games, elections, breaking news, viral moments. You partner with Market Liquidity & Operations when odds or liquidity shift. You stay calm when the calendar is nights, weekends, and holidays. Speed without sloppiness - you’re managing the public face of the product.
* Connect the calendar to the product. You own the calendar against sports, politics, culture, and market-moving news so launches aren’t a surprise to the homepage. You flag coverage gaps back to Market Ops before the story peaks.
* Make discovery exciting, not just functional. You treat the surface as the reason someone opens the app at all - fresh, current, a little addictive. You know the difference between a homepage that’s operational and one that makes someone want to check it again in twenty minutes.
* Prove it with experiments. You prioritize, QA, and read merchandising A/B tests with Product and Analytics against CTR, conversion, trading volume, and DAU/return-visit lift. You know when a test is invalid. You instrument your own funnel; you don’t wait for someone to hand you the analysis.
* Watch the competitive set and respond. You track competitors closely, and you propose responses, work with engineers and ship them.
* Handoff cleanly with Market Ops. You consume new listings the moment they’re live. You feed unmet demand and broken-resolution UX signals back. Market Ops handles the listing and settlement processes while you own the presentation of our customer-facing product interfaces.

### **Requirements:**

* Surface merchandising you've owned. You have owned sportsbook, iGaming, or marketplace merchandising (modules, features, packages) end-to-end, with a track record of improving engagement, conversion, or volume, and you adapt readily when things move fast and dependencies shift. We care what you've built and owned.
* Live / calendar ops under pressure. You operate comfortably on event time (nights, weekends, holidays), swapping and re-featuring quickly to keep the surface current as moments unfold.
* Data-informed, not gut-only. You are adept at defining success criteria and tracking them closely - using SQL, dashboards, or a partner analyst to decide what features, and reading what the data tells you against CTR, conversion, and volume/DAU impact. You make informed decisions and communicate the rationale with clarity so stakeholders understand.
* Experiment literacy. You design, run, and read A/B tests for merchandising or discovery with rigor, distinguishing valid signal from noise so winners and invalid tests are both handled with the same discipline.
* Cross-functional collaborator. You work closely with Product, Market Liquidity & Operations, and Marketing, communicating your decisions clearly, coordinating launches smoothly and adapting when the need arises.
* Domain fluency or fast learning speed. You're comfortable in both idioms - odds, parlays, and hold on one side; order books, contract pricing, and liquidity depth on the other - or you learn fast enough to engage power users credibly on both.

### **Preferred:**

* Sportsbook / iGaming merchandising. You have experience building and rotating homepage modules, parlay/SGP-style packages, and live in-game surfacing, with a craft for making a screen feel ur

jobs.title: Trust & Safety Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

We are hiring a Trust & Safety Product Operations Specialist to investigate safety incidents and work with the Product and Legal teams to prevent the next one. You will report to the Director of Trust & Safety. You will turn what cases and data show into product feedback and process fixes.

This role uses AI throughout. You will prompt it to query data and build tools, and you will answer for what it produces.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Investigations & Policy**

* Run safety investigations from intake through resolution. Weigh conflicting accounts against the evidence, and close each case with a written finding that a second reviewer can verify.
* Handle escalated tickets. Communicate clearly with professionals and partners, and with legal and law enforcement when a case requires it. Tie every resolution to the facts and to our terms.
* Apply Instawork’s Community Guidelines consistently, and propose revisions where cases expose gaps.

### **Data & Metrics**

* Use natural language to generate SQL for our databases. Review each query’s logic and verify its results before you act on them.
* Identify fraud patterns and safety trends yourself, without a technical intermediary. Report what the data supports and where it falls short.
* Track the metrics that show whether Trust & Safety is working, including incident rate, time to first action, appeal overturn rate, and repeat-violation rate. Report results to Product and Legal against targets set by the Director of Trust & Safety.
* Investigate the cause when a metric moves off target, and recommend a response.
* Re-review a sample of closed cases each month to check that findings are accurate and consistent.

### **Product Operations & Automation**

* Test new safety and enforcement features before launch, and send Product written defect reports.
* Help plan outreach to professionals and partners for each new feature, and track adoption from launch.
* Collect and analyze feedback from cases and support channels, and report what it implies for departmental and company planning.
* Build internal tools by prompting AI coding assistants. Check the logic and test the output before a tool touches a live case. Examples include scripts that assemble case evidence and workflows that route incoming reports. Keep data privacy and human review in each tool.
* Find the manual steps that slow investigations and replace them with automation or a tool you build. Maintain what you ship.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 1+ years in Trust & Safety, Operations, or Compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to weigh conflicting accounts and reach a fair finding under pressure, with a habit of checking your own bias.
* Daily professional use of AI to query data and build tools, and a working knowledge of where it fails.
* Fluency in Excel or Google Sheets, and comfort moving through internal systems to assemble facts.
* Experience tracking and reporting operational metrics, and judgment about which ones mislead.
* Ownership of each case until the underlying problem is solved.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* SQL, Python (Pandas), or a BI tool such as Looker or Tableau.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Replit, or with no-code tools such as Zapier.
* Experience working with external stakeholders such as clients, legal teams, or law enforcement.
* Experience testing or launching product features.

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. jobs.title: Multi-Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly capable, organized, and proactive professional to work directly with an entrepreneur who owns and operates multiple businesses across different industries and locations throughout the United States.

Our business interests include insurance, tax services, technology, professional services, media, and other developing ventures.

As our portfolio continues to grow, we are looking for someone who can help establish organization, coordinate operations, manage projects, and ensure important business initiatives consistently move forward.

This position combines elements of executive assistance, business operations, project management, and strategic coordination.

**We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We need a resourceful individual who can take initiative, solve problems, follow through, and take meaningful responsibilities off the business owner's plate.**

Key Responsibilities

**Multi-Business Operations**

* Help organize and coordinate operations across multiple companies.
* Establish centralized systems to track business activities, projects, and priorities.
* Ensure deadlines, deliverables, and business objectives are consistently followed up on.
* Assist with implementing processes that improve organization and efficiency.
* Identify operational problems and proactively develop solutions.

**Project Management**

* Turn business ideas and objectives into structured action plans.
* Coordinate new business launches, ongoing projects, and operational improvements.
* Track assignments and follow up with employees, contractors, and service providers.
* Research and coordinate resources needed to complete projects.
* Prepare progress reports and maintain visibility into active initiatives.

**Executive Support**

* Assist the founder with managing schedules, meetings, communications, and priorities.
* Organize important documents, business information, and administrative processes.
* Help manage email correspondence and follow-ups.
* Handle routine matters independently while escalating important decisions.
* Help the founder remain focused on growth, strategy, and high-level business decisions.

**Team & Vendor Coordination**

* Communicate with employees, managers, freelancers, and outside service providers across different locations.
* Track assignments, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Assist with hiring, onboarding, and coordinating personnel.
* Hold team members accountable for progress and completion.
* Improve communication and workflow between different businesses.

**Business Growth & Implementation**

* Assist with research, planning, and execution of new opportunities.
* Coordinate website, marketing, technology, and operational projects.
* Help implement new business systems, software, and automation.
* Assist with vendor comparisons, service sourcing, and other special projects.
* Help develop procedures that allow businesses to operate more independently.

Qualifications

* Experience in business operations, project management, executive assistance, or similar positions.
* Excellent organizational, multitasking, and communication skills.
* Strong independent problem-solving abilities.
* Experience managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and projects.
* Comfortable coordinating remote employees, contractors, and vendors.
* Proficient with modern business tools, project management software, and AI productivity applications.
* Ability to learn new industries and business processes quickly.
* Strong follow-through and attention to detail.
* Professional, dependable, and comfortable handling confidential business information.

Experience working directly with entrepreneurs, small-business owners, or multiple companies is highly desirable.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys making things happen.

You don't need every detail explained before getting started. You know how to research, organize, follow up, and find solutions.

You are comfortable working with a business owner who has multiple projects and ideas in motion and can help turn those ideas into organized, actionable plans.

You take pride in completing projects, keeping people accountable, and creating systems that make organizations run more efficiently.

Expectations During the First 90 Days

* Establish an organized overview of all active businesses and projects.
* Create a centralized project and task management system.
* Implement weekly priorities and progress reporting.
* Establish consistent follow-up procedures with employees and contractors.
* Take ownership of recurring administrative and coordination responsibilities.
* Demonstrate measurable progress on priority business initiatives.
* Reduce the amount of time the founder spends managing routine operations.

Growth Opportunity

This position offers significant growth potential. The right candidate may eventually advance into a Director of Operations or Chief of Staff role as responsibilities expand.

We are looking for a long-term professional relationship with someone who wants to play an important role in building and managing a growing portfolio of businesses.

How to Apply

Submit your resume along with a brief explanation of your experience supporting business owners, organizing multiple projects, or coordinating business operations.

Please include an example of a project or operational challenge you independently managed from start to completion.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $72,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote
